summary_id: 13 alur layanan resmi Dinsos P2PA Demak (pengaduan Puskesos, SKT DTSEN, PBI kesehatan, kekerasan terhadap perempuan dan anak, bantuan bencana, rehabilitasi disabilitas, adopsi, dan lainnya), terjemahan bahasa Inggris.

title: Law 11/2009 on Social Welfare
summary: Social Welfare Law: social rehabilitation, social security, empowerment and protection, and the duties of central and local government and social workers.
summary_id: UU Kesejahteraan Sosial: rehabilitasi sosial, jaminan sosial, pemberdayaan, dan perlindungan sosial, serta tugas pemerintah pusat, daerah, dan pekerja sosial.

title: Minister of Social Affairs Regulation 1/2018 on the Family Hope Programme (PKH)
summary: Family Hope Programme (PKH): who is eligible, benefit components, family obligations, PKH companions, payments and complaints.
summary_id: Program Keluarga Harapan (PKH): syarat penerima, komponen bantuan, kewajiban keluarga, pendamping PKH, penyaluran, dan pengaduan.

title: Minister of Social Affairs Regulation 4/2023 on the Sembako food aid programme
summary: Sembako food aid (BPNT): targeting from the social welfare data, distribution through e-warong agents, amounts, monitoring, complaints and banned practices such as levies.
summary_id: Bantuan Sembako (BPNT): penetapan penerima dari data kesejahteraan sosial, penyaluran melalui e-warong, besaran, pemantauan, pengaduan, dan larangan pungutan.

title: Law 8/2016 on Persons with Disabilities
summary: Persons with Disabilities Law: rights to education, health, work, accessibility and social welfare, and the services government must provide.
summary_id: UU Penyandang Disabilitas: hak atas pendidikan, kesehatan, pekerjaan, aksesibilitas, dan kesejahteraan sosial, serta layanan yang wajib disediakan pemerintah.

title: Law 13/1998 on the Welfare of Older Persons
summary: Welfare of Older Persons Law: social services, protection and assistance for people aged 60 and over, especially those who are neglected.
summary_id: UU Kesejahteraan Lanjut Usia: pelayanan sosial, perlindungan, dan bantuan bagi warga 60 tahun ke atas, terutama yang terlantar.

title: Law 24/2007 on Disaster Management
summary: Disaster Management Law: preparedness, emergency response and recovery, the roles of BNPB and BPBD, and affected people's right to aid and basic needs.
summary_id: UU Penanggulangan Bencana: kesiapsiagaan, tanggap darurat, dan pemulihan, peran BNPB dan BPBD, serta hak warga terdampak atas bantuan dan kebutuhan dasar.

title: Law 23/2004 on the Elimination of Domestic Violence (PKDRT)
summary: Domestic Violence Law (PKDRT): physical, psychological and sexual violence and neglect in the household; victims' rights, protection orders, police duties and criminal penalties.
summary_id: UU Penghapusan Kekerasan dalam Rumah Tangga (PKDRT): kekerasan fisik, psikis, seksual, dan penelantaran dalam rumah tangga; hak korban, perintah perlindungan, kewajiban polisi, dan sanksi pidana.

title: Law 12/2022 on Sexual Violence Crimes (TPKS)
summary: Sexual Violence Crimes Law (TPKS): defines sexual harassment, forced marriage, sexual exploitation, electronic sexual violence and other offences; victims' rights to treatment, protection, recovery and restitution; services through UPTD PPA.
summary_id: UU Tindak Pidana Kekerasan Seksual (TPKS): pelecehan seksual, pemaksaan perkawinan, eksploitasi seksual, kekerasan seksual berbasis elektronik, dan tindak pidana lain; hak korban atas penanganan, pelindungan, pemulihan, dan restitusi; layanan melalui UPTD PPA.

title: Law 35/2014 amending Law 23/2002 on Child Protection
summary: Child Protection Law: children's rights and the duties of the state, parents and society; bans violence, exploitation and sexual abuse of children with criminal sanctions; special protection; establishes KPAI.
summary_id: UU Perlindungan Anak: hak anak serta kewajiban negara, orang tua, dan masyarakat; larangan kekerasan, eksploitasi, dan kekerasan seksual terhadap anak beserta sanksi pidana; perlindungan khusus; dasar KPAI.

title: Minister of Women Empowerment and Child Protection Regulation 4/2018 on establishing UPTD PPA (women and child protection units)
issuer: Ministry of Women Empowerment and Child Protection
summary: Sets up the UPTD PPA units for women and children: complaint intake, outreach, case management, temporary shelter, mediation and assistance.
summary_id: Pembentukan UPTD PPA: penerimaan pengaduan, penjangkauan, pengelolaan kasus, penampungan sementara, mediasi, dan pendampingan bagi perempuan dan anak.

title: Law 16/2019 amending the Marriage Law (minimum marriage age 19)
summary: Raises the minimum marriage age to 19 for women and men; a court may grant dispensation only for urgent reasons with supporting evidence.
summary_id: Menaikkan batas usia perkawinan menjadi 19 tahun bagi perempuan dan laki-laki; dispensasi pengadilan hanya untuk alasan mendesak dengan bukti pendukung.

title: PANRB Ministerial Regulation 5/2025 on public service complaint management
issuer: Ministry of Administrative and Bureaucratic Reform
summary: Public service complaint management: complaint channels including SP4N-LAPOR!, handling deadlines, follow-up and reporting duties of agencies.
summary_id: Pengelolaan pengaduan pelayanan publik: kanal pengaduan termasuk SP4N-LAPOR!, batas waktu penanganan, tindak lanjut, dan kewajiban pelaporan instansi.
